13 July 2027 · Brussels

Nineteen alumni contributions, in order of joining Rodolphe, followed by his response and close. Four sessions of five contributions run from 09:00 to 17:20. Each slot includes a 15-minute talk and 5 minutes for questions, with two 20-minute coffee breaks and a one-hour lunch.

Tentative programme · local time. Talk titles and participation are to be confirmed.

How the order was established

Order the 19 alumni by earliest documented year of joining Sepulchre as PhD student or postdoc. For same-year cohorts, use alphabetical surname order because exact order of arrival is not established consistently. More explicit personal career records are used for Franci and Miranda-Villatoro where they conflict with the roster. Rodolphe Sepulchre is placed last for his response and close.

  • Date discrepancy: Sepulchre's roster says 2011–2015; Franci's personal biography states a 2012 PhD and postdoctoral research during 2012–2015 at Liège, INRIA Lille and Cambridge. Use 2012 as the more explicit personal career record; exact beginning with Sepulchre remains source-disputed. Source 1 · Source 2
  • Date discrepancy: Sepulchre's roster says 2017–2020, but Miranda-Villatoro's own Inria biography explicitly states Cambridge Research Associate March 2018–September 2020 and PhD 2018. Use the more precise 2018 personal record; 2017 is not a settled start date. Source 1 · Source 2
